questions.stem: Which statement best explains why there are fewer top predators than herbivores in an ecosystem?

options.text: Top predators reproduce more slowly than herbivores
Energy is lost at each trophic level, so there is less energy available to support organisms at higher levels
Herbivores are better adapted to their environment
Top predators need less food to survive

questions.explanation: At each trophic level, around 90% of energy is lost through respiration, movement, and as heat. This means there is progressively less energy available at each level to support organisms, so fewer top predators can be sustained compared to herbivores.
